svg.title: Monticello Villas — HOA / Security map icon set
svg.desc: Vector map pin set for the Guardhouse security portal and the resident mobile app. Every pin is a reusable <symbol>: reference one with <use href="#pin-fire"/>. Geometry is uniform — 20px head radius, 24px icon, 8px internal padding, 46px tip drop.
svg.text: Map Icon Set — HOA / Security Interface
Monticello Villas · one geometry, three semantic clusters · 20px head · 24px glyph · 8px internal padding

g.text: Live danger. Red is reserved for these three and nothing else.

4 · In context — premises boundary, markers, callout
Every marker sits on its own anchor point. The boundary reads as a limit, never as a filled region that competes with the pins.
Callout text is verbatim from the brief — see the note on Phase 4.
Head and glyph are fixed, so every icon in the set optically matches every other.
Unmodified. The white ring is what carries them across both themes.
